P1 budget is a different explicitly declared matrix, not claim of587day speedup.

comparator.selected: Yeong–Torquato correlation-constrained simulated annealing, explicit four-phase/hard-clamp adaptation
comparator.publication: Yeong & Torquato (1998), Physical Review E58,224, DOI10.1103/PhysRevE.58.224
comparator.published_scope: 3D reconstruction from 2D two-point probability and lineal-path statistics; retrieved abstract does not establish multiphase hard-clamp implementation.
comparator.implementation_contract: New revision adapter, not claim of original author code: fit per-phase target two-point and lineal-path descriptors only from registered train planes. Initialize train-prior categorical labels; clamp identical observation mask/values. Swap two unobserved valid voxels; observations never proposed. Objective weights and annealing schedule fixed using validation only. No target truth statistics or test phase fractions.
comparator.fair_constraints: Same ROI grid, phase semantics, observations, valid support, observation-excluded evaluation; report compute and descriptor-target mismatch rather than assert strongest published implementation.
comparator.rejected: Unconditional GAN not automatically fair. SNESIM/MPSlib hard-data interface verified, but requires representative3D training image absent under sparse-plane information parity; no dense source training image permitted.
